title: Turn a failure into one focused recovery
when: A check times out, source is absent remotely, or install just completed
need: Preserve exact failure/partial result, use the named check recovery and scoped rerun. Remote and local source halves have different authority. The focused install check in E is planned, not the current general Doctor.
surface: Existing Doctor contract supports named recovery; FIRST-USER E adds install selection and plain next steps.
